Hi Vanessa,

Thanks — we received the DPA and subprocessors list. A couple of notes from our side after quick review: 

1) SOC 2 link resolves but procurement needs confirmation of the report date and whether there are any outstanding exceptions. Can you confirm the audit date and whether any exceptions were noted?

2) Subprocessors CSV looks good; please confirm whether any planned changes are expected in the next 90 days (we classify planned additions differently).

3) On the DPA, our legal team will request one narrow edit: add a clause limiting the use of subprocessor notifications to email + 30 days. If Redwood is open to that (or a standard alternative), please advise if we should route suggested redline language to your legal contact.

If we can get answers to those three points we'll proceed to open the PO and share the Coupa vendor setup link.

Procurement Team
StratusWorks

Hi team — looping in Redwood Legal (Evelyn) and Finance (Marcus) to address the three procurement questions below. Summary and answers: 

1) SOC 2: Audit period: 2025-07-01 through 2026-06-30; the report attached to the hosted link is the full Type II attestation and contains zero carve-outs or open exceptions. If you need an excerpt or signed cover letter we can provide one.

2) Subprocessors: No planned additions in the next 90 days. We do quarterly reviews; any additions are communicated via email to customers per our standard policy.

3) DPA redline request: Evelyn — our legal team is OK with adding a subprocessor notification clause of email + 30 days. Evelyn, can you confirm the exact language you'd accept and whether Redwood should provide a tracked redline?

Marcus — please proceed with vendor setup once procurement confirms the legal entity: StratusWorks LLC (EIN: 12-3456789), billing contact: accounts-payable@stratusworks.com. Vanessa — confirmed the PO billing contact above with Laura offline.
